envelope.description: Add the issueOps group to the adapter

body.title: Add the issueOps group to the adapter
body.summary: Implement IssueOps on the adapter: create returning the CreatedIssue shape, linkSubIssue taking the numeric child id, close, comment, readBody, writeBody, ensureLabel keeping its boolean, ensureMilestone keeping its swallow and attachMilestone, each running the same gh argv as its wrapper, with port.createIssue wrapping issueOps.create.
acceptanceChecks: Each issueOps operation runs the same gh argv as its wrapper, compared with a recording fake gh
Epic, Story and Task specs produce the same labels, issue type and parent link as the current calls, and a failed parent link does not fail the create
ensureLabel returns false on failure, ensureMilestone swallows a failed create and closing a closed issue succeeds
